newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Stevedores at Brazil Paranagua do not join strike.
newsitem.headline: Stevedores at Brazil Paranagua do not join strike.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's key grains port of Paranagua are not participating in a 48-hour national strike which was due to have started at 0700 local/1000 GMT, a union official said on Friday.
"We had a meeting yesterday and we decided that we are not going to stop," the official said.

The strike was called to show support for workers in Santos who began an indefinite stoppage as of 0700 local/1000 GMT April 15 in protest at a local steel firm using its own workers at its private terminal in Santos.
The national strike call is the second this month.
On April 4, some 85 percent of stevedores in Brazil stopped work in sympathy with Santos colleagues.
On that occasion Paranagua workers stopped for one hour during the day and even then maintained operations throughout at the grains export terminal.
